name: Glameep
description: Draped in fresh green leaf-feathers, Glameep moves lightly along the lake shore. It adores clear water most of all, especially when that water reflects its own graceful, unhurried beauty.

forms.name: Basic Form

skills.name: Baa-Baa Leaf Shot
skills.description: Launches a Grass Orb at the target. On hit, reduces its —Grass Resistance for 20s. While in the [Energy Full] state, Grass-type Aniimo in your team deal 15% increased damage for 20s.

skills.name: Baa Bubble Wave
skills.description: Launches a bubble wave that deals damage to enemies hit, while also granting allies along its path a Shield worth 7.0% of the caster’s Max HP for 10s. In the [Energy Full] state, the Shield value is increased to 14.0%.

traits.description: Each basic attack triggers the [Gacha] once, randomly firing an orange, purple, blue, or gold bubble and adding that bubble color to the gacha slots. name: Scrubbit
description: Though it’s round and chubby, Scrubbit is surprisingly nimble. That shed long tail-leaf in its hands is both a scrub towel for washing its body and a sharp tool for whipping opponents.

forms.name: Basic Form

skills.name: Frogs Love Baths
skills.description: Swings forward to deal 3 hits of damage. If the target has at least 10 stacks of [Water Debuff], consumes 3 stacks to increase this skill’s Might by 35%.

skills.description: Wields the power of water to attack targets at close range.

skills.description: Unleashes consecutive flying kicks forward, and restores 3% of own max HP.

skills.name: Rain-Pond Leaf Strike
skills.description: Dashes forward and launches upward, reducing the target’s healing received by 70% for 20s.

traits.name: Thoughtful Service
traits.description: The final hit of a Basic Attack marks the target on the farther side with [Sludge]. Hitting the marked side with a skill removes it, dealing damage equal to 35 Might, and heals the caster for 3% Max HP.

traits.name: Sludge Clearing
traits.description: The final hit of a basic attack marks the target on the side farther from the caster with [Bruise]. When a skill hits the [Bruise] side, removes [Bruise], deals damage equal to 35 Might, and applies 6 stacks of [Water Debuff].

description: The queen of the swarm and the hive’s highest ruler, she is revered by her kin and lives within the royal nest the workers craft for her, commanding the entire swarm.

forms.name: Basic Form

skills.name: Queen’s Blessing

skills.name: ATK

description: They need to absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots to maintain vitality and hate leaving the ground.

traits.name: Prank Master

description: They live in caves, feed on minerals, and use their beautifully crystallized shells to lure prey.

skills.name: Ice Spikes
skills.description: Creates an ice spike ahead, attacking and [freezing] the target for 2.5s. Can be used during tunneling. Afterward, dashes forward and emerges from underground.

skills.name: Icy Gravel Dance
skills.description: Summons an Ice Storm that continuously builds up [Ice Debuff] on targets. The Ice Storm keeps moving forward until it hits a wall or a target.

skills.name: Freezing Claws
skills.description: Deals damage over a large area.

skills.name: Frost Slam
skills.description: Gathers icy vapor in both pincers, then slams them down to deal AoE damage in front and create an ice wall for 5s.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: (BREAK) Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

name: Prawnch
description: Prawnch trains hard in the rapids, raising its claw-fists high and picking fights with every opponent in sight. It even treats passing creatures as imaginary enemies. The more it gets ignored, the more it itches to throw down.

forms.name: Basic Form

skills.name: Spring Fist
skills.description: Compresses the pincer-arm spring to charge up, then throws 3 punches. Each hit can trigger the trait effect. Charging increases the attack range and Might by 30%. The 1st and 2nd charged attacks knock the target back; after the 3rd charged attack hits, dashes forward.

skills.name: Spring Combo
skills.description: Tenses up the pincer arms to charge, then throws a flurry of punches forward; can move while attacking. Deals extra damage equal to 20% Might to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff]. Charging increases the attack range, and the number of attacks by 30%.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

traits.description: The first time a skill hits a target, gains 1 Strike Points. After charging, the skill’s first hit grants 2 points. skills.description: Unleashes a lion’s roar imbued with holy power to attack targets. On hit, increases the user’s Light Damage Amp by 6%, stacking up to 3 times for 20s. [Solar Halo] enhances this skill’s effect, applying 3 stacks each time.

skills.name: Helios’ Judgment
skills.description: Unleashes Helios’ Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage. Evolves into Soleon, increases its own Damage Amp by 15% until leaving combat, and gains Ring of the Golden Sun.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of light to attack targets at close range.

skills.name: Light Bombardment
skills.description: Dives from the air at the target, causing a Holy Light explosion upon landing. If this Aniimo has [Solar Halo], this hit deals 30% more damage and restores 4% HP. There is also a 75% chance this skill will not consume [Solar Halo].

traits.name: Solar Grace
traits.description: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 30%. Every 4 basic attacks grants [Solar Halo], enhancing the next skill.

mobility.name: Hustle
mobility.description: Enters the Hustle state to move at high speed by continuously consuming stamina.

forms.description: As the golden radiance flows over their bodies like the power of the sun, their majesty is revealed.

description: Enthusiastic and confident, they always stand up for their friends at critical moments, displaying amazing power.
